Soundboard

Get Soundboard

A DJ app for iPhone, Android and Mac with a separate headphone cue, simple enough to mix two tracks in seconds and deep enough to play a full set.

Version 0.2.1 · released 2026-11-07 · All rights reserved · requires macOS 14 and Xcode 15 for the apps, CMake 3.16 for the engine, Node 20 and Python 3 for the checks

Commands

make setup        # check the toolchain; generate the Xcode project
make dev          # open the Xcode project (macOS) or serve the docs site
make up           # serve the docs site in Docker at localhost:8052; make down stops it
make validate     # every check, then the tests
make e2e          # open every site page; check links, assets and anchors
make site-serve   # serve public/ at localhost:8052 without Docker
make dist         # dist/soundboard-0.2.1.zip and .sha256 from tracked files

Connect an agent

Soundboard has no MCP server of its own. Give an agent the repository through a filesystem server and point it at AGENTS.md and public/llm.txt:

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "soundboard": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "-y",
        "@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem",
        "/path/to/Soundboard"
      ]
    }
  }
}

Then check the repository against Station from the command line:

npx @stationprotocol/station check
make validate
